build.//: Just the build. Nixpacks' install phase already ran npm ci, and it mounts a cache at /app/node_modules/.cache — a second npm ci here tries to wipe node_modules and dies with EBUSY on that mountpoint. vite sits in dependencies rather than devDependencies so the install phase brings it in even though Nixpacks sets NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=true.

deploy.//: server.js uses only node:http, so nothing from node_modules is needed at runtime.
